definitions.explanation: A man who is attractive in appearance. Combination of イケてる (cool/attractive) and メン (men/face).

examples.english: He's a good-looking guy, isn't he?

examples.japanese: イケメン{俳優|はいゆう}がドラマに{出|で}ている。
examples.english: A handsome actor is in the drama.

examples.japanese: この{店|みせ}はイケメンの{店員|てんいん}が{多|おお}い。
examples.english: This shop has many good-looking staff members.

notes: Popular slang combining イケてる (cool, attractive) and メン (men or {面|めん} face). The female equivalent is sometimes イケジョ or {美人|びじん}. Can be used as a prefix: イケメン{俳優|はいゆう} (handsome actor). Became widespread in the 2000s.
